leftEvidence.title: God creates, speaks, and light appears

points.label: Opening phrase
points.left: Genesis begins, 'In the beginning, God created.'
points.right: John begins, 'In the beginning was the Word.'

points.label: Creation
points.left: God creates heavens and earth and speaks light into the scene.
points.right: All things are said to come into being through the Word.

points.label: Light
points.left: Light is separated from darkness and named day.
points.right: Life in the Word is called the light of people, shining in darkness.

payload.posture: Hold the two openings together without flattening either into the other.

rightEvidence.title: The Word, creation, life, and light appear together

payload.tension: Both passages begin with creation language, but Genesis names God creating while John distinguishes God and the Word and says all things came through the Word.
payload.title: Beginning / beginning
